create_SamePad_non_causal: create a SamePad module with a given kernel size for non-causal padding removal
create_SamePad_causal: create a SamePad module with causal=True to remove kernel_size minus one timesteps
run_SamePad_forward: run the SamePad forward pass to trim trailing timesteps from a 3D tensor
create_SamePad2d: create a SamePad2d module with a given kernel size for 2D padding removal
run_SamePad2d_forward: run the SamePad2d forward pass to trim trailing spatial dimensions from a 4D tensor
